title: Format and Pricing
description: Historical pass pricing and programme format for the Hong Kong 2013 OpenStack Summit, comparing General Session & Expo and Full Access passes.
body:
Two Tiers of Registration are available for the Hong Kong Summit. Please read closely to choose which pass is best for you.

Register here: https://openstacksummitnovember2013.eventbrite.co.uk

Tier 1) General Session & Expo Pass - USD $300:

  • Days: Access to the Summit Tuesday & Wednesday ONLY
  • Tracks: Access to keynote presentations and the general session room track only, running all day Tuesday & Wednesday, covering how to get started with OpenStack, architectural overview, business value and user case studies
  • Translation from English to Mandarin will be offered in the General Session
  • Expo: Access to sponsor expo hall, booths and happy hour
  • Meals: Lunch, snacks, coffee and tea provided Tuesday & Wednesday

Tier 2) Full Access Pass - USD $1000:

  • Days: Access to the Summit ALL four days, Tuesday - Friday
  • Tracks: Access to keynote presentations, the general session room track, and all breakout sessions, including topics like operations, security, strategy, community building, operations, technical deep dives, workshops and the Design Summit working sessions for Active Technical Contributors
  • Expo: Access to sponsor expo hall, booths and happy hour
  • Meals: Lunch, snacks, coffee and tea provided Tuesday - Friday
  • Summit bag and sponsor giveaways
